Done. Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/cli/HelpFormatterAgentTest.java` — the only file added.

## Approach

**Project conventions checked:** `pom.xml` pins `junit:junit:3.8.2`, and every existing test (`OptionsTest`, `ArgumentIsOptionTest`, …) extends `junit.framework.TestCase` with `testXxx()` methods and no annotations. Source level is Java 1.4, so the test uses raw types (`Comparator`, `List`), no generics/enhanced-for/autoboxing, `StringBuffer` not `StringBuilder`. Matched that exactly.

**Coverage (34 tests, public API only):**
- **Constants & defaults** — `DEFAULT_*` values; `getWidth/getLeftPadding/getDescPadding/getSyntaxPrefix/getOptPrefix/getLongOptPrefix/getLongOptSeparator/getArgName/getNewLine/getOptionComparator` initial values.
- **Accessors round-trip** including boundary values (width `0`, `-10`; empty syntax prefix) and consistency between the deprecated public fields (`defaultWidth`, …) and the getters/setters.
- **`setOptionComparator`** — keeps a custom comparator (`assertSame`), and `null` restores a fresh non-custom default (`assertNotSame`); observable ordering effect verified via a reverse comparator producing `usage: app [-c] [-b] [-a]`.
- **`printUsage`** — plain syntax, custom/empty syntax prefix, generated-from-`Options` (`usage: myapp [-a] [-b <arg>]`), required options not bracketed (`[-o] -r`), option groups (`[-b | -f]`), and long-syntax wrapping with every line ≤ width.
- **`printOptions`** — exact single-option layout (`" -a   desc a"`), short+long+description rendering with sort order, custom opt/long-opt prefixes, `longOptSeparator` (`-f,--file=<FILE>`), default arg name fallback (`<PARAM>`), long-description wrapping bounded by width.
- **`printWrapped`** — short text unchanged, wrap-at-whitespace (lines ≤ width, no words lost), hard chop when a word exceeds width (`abcde`/`fghij`/`klmno`), continuation-line padding via `nextLineTabStop`, embedded `\n` handling.
- **`printHelp`** — full layout ordering (usage → header → options → footer), `autoUsage` true vs false, blank header/footer skipped, `System.out` overload (captured), width-overload header wrapping, and error cases: `null` and `""` `cmdLineSyntax` both throw `IllegalArgumentException` with message `"cmdLineSyntax not provided"`.

## Verification

- `defects4j compile` → `Running ant (compile)... OK` / `Running ant (compile.tests)... OK`
- `java -cp $(defects4j export -p cp.test) junit.textui.TestRunner org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatterAgentTest` → `OK (34 tests)`
